hero_swirl_spec.container: relative w-full h-screen bg-[#0F2A44] overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center
hero_swirl_spec.description: Animated SVG/CSS blobs over a deep navy base transitioning to light lavender at the bottom.

blobs.classes: absolute w-[40vw] h-[40vw] rounded-full mix-blend-screen filter blur-[100px] opacity-70 animate-[spin_20s_linear_infinite]
absolute w-[30vw] h-[30vw] rounded-full mix-blend-screen filter blur-[80px] opacity-60 animate-[spin_25s_linear_infinite_reverse] translate-x-1/4
absolute w-[50vw] h-[50vw] rounded-full mix-blend-multiply filter blur-[120px] opacity-80

hero_swirl_spec.transition_overlay: absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-48 bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent to-[#E7E7F7]

layout_blueprint.Nav: Sticky header (z-50) using light glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#E7E7F7]/70 border-b border-white/50`). Left: Logo. Right: Anchors to sections.
layout_blueprint.Hero: Deep oceanic base `#0F2A44`. Behind the text, the CSS animated swirl. Text: 'Climate Positive Desalination' in white, Chivo font. Gradient fade at bottom bridging to `#E7E7F7`.
layout_blueprint.Problem: Grid layout (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Light glass cards resting on the `#E7E7F7` bg. Titles: High energy cost, Hazardous waste, Skilled dependency, $31B stale tech.
layout_blueprint.ParadigmBanner: Full width, deep oceanic blue `#0F2A44` background. Large white text: 'Desalination doesn't have to cost energy. It can generate it.' Accented with the ocean wave texture masked seamlessly with low opacity.
layout_blueprint.Process4Step: Bento-style or linear grid mapping 'Feed waste → Deionize → Harvest energy → Close loop'. Minimalist layout using lucide-react icons, connected by subtle lines.
layout_blueprint.PerformanceStats: 3 prominent glassmorphism stat cards overlapping a soft radial gradient. Accent color `#A3E635` used strictly for the massive numbers: '>0 Wh/L', '<500 ppm', '$0 feedstock'.
layout_blueprint.ComparisonTable: Standard Tailwind table layout. Table headers bold. Highlight the CPSD row/column using a subtle `#138A72`/10 background and white/glass border to make it stand out against RO and ED.
layout_blueprint.MarketFunnel: Visual arrangement of 3 layers (Concentric circles or cascading glass cards) showcasing $30B TAM, $4B SAM, $40M SOM.
layout_blueprint.Team: Grid with 3 profile cards for Dr. Purnima Jalihal, Abhishek Padmanabhan, Dr. VMV Sai Krishna. Light glassmorphism cards. Clean layout, image on top, name/title below.
layout_blueprint.Contact: Minimal footer-preceding section. Mailto CTA button modeled as a large glass element with hover effect. Contact info displayed cleanly.
layout_blueprint.Footer: Dark `#0F2A44` background, white text. Logo display, copyright, and subtle anchor links.

motion.entrance: Use framer-motion for staggering lists/cards. Elements should slide up by 20px and fade in with a duration of 0.6s and ease-out.
motion.hover: Interactive cards should lift (`-translate-y-1`) and increase the opacity of their border and shadow.
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling is required for all anchor links.

do_not_list: NO saturated purple or violet gradients anywhere.
NO dark text on dark backgrounds.
NO white text on the light lavender background.
NO generic tech fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Stick to Chivo + Figtree.
NO generic standard SaaS hero image; strictly use the CSS/SVG animated swirl.
NO placeholder domains for missing images, use the provided Unsplash URLs.
NO teal in the standard backgrounds, use it strictly as an accent for the swirl and highlights.
